arxiv-2209-09209.description: Abstract Drones are employed in a growing number of visual recognition applications. A recent development in cell tower inspection is drone-based asset surveillance, where the autonomous flight of a drone is guided by localizing objects of interest in successive aerial images.

arxiv-2303-11777.title: Quasi Maximum Likelihood Estimation of High-Dimensional Factor Models: A Critical Review
arxiv-2303-11777.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . We review Quasi Maximum Likelihood estimation of factor models for high-dimensional panels of time series. We consider two cases: (1) estimation when no dynamic model for the factors is specified ( Bai and Li 2012 ; Bai and Li 2016 ) ; (2) estimation based on the Kalman smoother and the Expectation Maximization algorithm thus allowing to model explicitly the factor dynamics ( Doz et al. 2012 ; Barigozzi and Luciani 2019 ) .

arxiv-2501-01398.title: A Proof of Concept Resource Management Scheme for Augmented Reality Applications in 5G Systems Thanks: Identify applicable funding agency here. If none, delete this.
arxiv-2501-01398.creator: Panagiotis Nikolaidis 1 , Samie Mostafavi 2 , James Gross 2 and John Baras 1
arxiv-2501-01398.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Panagiotis Nikolaidis 1 , Samie Mostafavi 2 , James Gross 2 and John Baras 1. Augmented reality applications are bitrate intensive, delay-sensitive, and computationally demanding. To support them, mobile edge computing systems need to carefully manage both their networking and computing resources. To this end, we present a proof of concept resource management scheme that adapts the bandwidth at the base station and the GPU frequency at the edge to efficiently fulfill roundtrip delay constrains.

arxiv-2501-08883.title: Increasing Batch Size Improves Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent with Momentum
arxiv-2501-08883.creator: Keisuke Kamo, Hideaki Iiduka
arxiv-2501-08883.description: Abstract Stochastic gradient descent with momentum (SGDM), in which a momentum term is added to SGD, has been well studied in both theory and practice. The theoretical studies show that the settings of the learning rate and momentum weight affect the convergence of SGDM. Meanwhile, the practical studies have shown that the batch-size setting strongly affects the performance of SGDM.

arxiv-2505-03073.title: Coupling the Heart to Musical Machines
arxiv-2505-03073.creator: Eric Easthope
arxiv-2505-03073.description: Abstract . Biofeedback is being used more recently as a general control paradigm for human-computer interfaces (HCIs). While biofeedback especially from breath has seen increasing uptake as a controller for novel musical interfaces, new interfaces for musical expression (NIMEs), the community has not given as much attention to the heart.

arxiv-2505-06416.title: ScaleMCP: Dynamic and Auto-Synchronizing Model Context Protocol Tools for LLM Agents
arxiv-2505-06416.creator: Elias Lumer, Anmol Gulati, Vamse Kumar Subbiah
arxiv-2505-06416.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and the introduction of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) have significantly expanded LLM agents’ capability to interact dynamically with external tools and APIs. However, existing tool selection frameworks do not integrate MCP servers, instead relying heavily on error-prone manual updates to monolithic local tool repositories, leading to duplication, inconsistencies, and inefficiencies.

arxiv-2602-02720.description: Abstract We study dimension-eight effects in the Standard Model Effective Field Theory extended by right-handed neutrinos ( ν ​ SMEFT \nu\text{SMEFT} ). pmc-11466301.description: BackgroundNon-obstructive azoospermia (NOA) is a major contributor of male infertility. pmc-11481755.title: Electrical stimulation for cartilage tissue engineering - A critical review from an engineer's perspective
pmc-11481755.creator: Julius Zimmermann, Abdul Razzaq Farooqi, Ursula van Rienen
pmc-11481755.description: Cartilage has a limited intrinsic healing capacity. Hence, cartilage degradation and lesions pose a huge clinical challenge, particularly in an ageing society. Osteoarthritis impacts a significant number of the population and requires the development of repair and tissue engineering methods for hyaline articular cartilage. In this context, electrical stimulation has been investigated for more than 50 years already.

pmc-11628208.title: Predicting the Difficult Neonatal Airway in Fetuses With Micrognathia, Oropharyngeal or Neck Mass Lesions: Two‐Center Experience With Fetal MRI

pmc-11628208.description: ObjectiveNeonatal airway compromise requiring intubation, due to micrognathia or a mass lesion obstructing the fetal airway, remains difficult but important to predict prenatally. pmc-12552171.description: Background and ObjectiveAnxiety is a prevalent emotional problem in children, with family functioning serving as a protective factor.
